items.title: 5.9.1 Liquids ke boiling points par asar karne wale awamil (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.9.1, printed pages 107-108.

blocks.text: Intermolecular forces jitni mazboot, vapour pressure utna kam aur boiling point utna zyada. Pani ka zyada boiling point ethanol aur methanol se mazboot intermolecular forces dikhata hai.

blocks.caption: 760 torr par kuch aam liquids ke boiling points (Table 5.4)

blocks.text: Kyunke liquid tab ubalta hai jab us ka vapour pressure bairooni dabao ke barabar ho, bairooni dabao badalne se boiling point badalta hai. Zyada bairooni dabao par liquid ko apna vapour pressure bairooni dabao tak lane ke liye zyada hararat chahiye, to boiling point barhta hai; kam bairooni dabao par woh kam hararat leta hai aur kam darja hararat par ubalta hai. Pani 1489 torr par 120 degrees C par aur 23.7 torr par 25 degrees C par ubalta hai; Murree ki paharion mein, jahan bairooni dabao 700 torr hai, 98 degrees C par, aur Mount Everest ki choti par 323 torr par sirf 69 degrees C par. Pressure cooker bairooni dabao masnooi taur par barhata hai: yeh band bartan hai jis mein pani ke bukharat nikal nahi sakte, to woh pani ki satah par zyada dabao banate hain aur ubalne ka darja hararat barhta hai; pani zyada hararat jazb karta hai aur khana jaldi pakta hai.

blocks.caption: Pani ka boiling point aur bairooni dabao

blocks.prompt: Oonchai par khana pakana mushkil kyun hai, pressure cooker mein khana tez kyun pakta hai, aur pani (100 degrees C) ethanol (78 degrees C) se oonche darje par kyun ubalta hai halanke dono mein hydrogen bonds hain?
blocks.explanation: Oonchai par bairooni dabao kam hai, to pani 100 degrees C se neeche ubalta hai aur khana jaldi pakne ke liye kabhi kaafi garam nahi hota. Pressure cooker bukharat rok kar pani par dabao barhata hai aur yun us ka boiling point 100 degrees C se oopar le jata hai; garam pani khana tez pakata hai. Pani fi molecule do hydrogen bonds banata hai aur ethanol sirf ek, to pani ki intermolecular forces mazboot, us ka vapour pressure kam aur boiling point zyada hai.

items: Mazboot intermolecular forces: kam vapour pressure, zyada boiling point (pani 100 > ethanol 78.3; naphthalene 218, acetic acid 118.5, CS2 46.3 degrees C).

Zyada bairooni dabao boiling point barhata hai, kam dabao ghatata hai: pani 1489 torr par 120 degrees C, Murree (700 torr) par 98, Everest (323 torr) par 69, 23.7 torr par 25 par ubalta hai; pressure cooker isi par chalta hai.
